content: Xuti meta Wuhutsi kememɨteyukaxei
Merikɨtsɨ mu'eya Nuhemi mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: ―Neuxei neniwe. Xɨari peuyewetse nemɨmatsikuwawirienikɨ hakewa pemekani 'aixɨa 'anemekɨ tixaɨtɨ pekareuyehɨatɨ.
Matsitɨ Wuhutsi te'uximayatsiriwamete wahetsɨa pepeta'axe, mɨkɨ pɨta'iwa. Mɨkɨ, 'ikɨ tɨkariyaritsie mana penuani tsewara matikatsiwatsie.

Keneti'ɨwa, witsimu'ɨa keneu'atawirieka meta 'akemari 'aixɨa mɨ'anene kenanakatɨxɨaka. Kenemie tsewara matikatsiwatsie. Pepɨkaheyuhekɨatani kapa mɨpaɨ retimanikɨ, kepaukake mɨretahayewa rekwatɨ meta re'ietɨ 'anake.
Kepaukari meyemie hekahunike, kene'a'ɨwiya hakewa mekahuni. 'Anake pepeyemie, 'ɨkayatsie pe'enuku'ɨkaripieme, mana pepekahuni. Hikɨ mɨkɨ yapetayɨni kepemɨtiyurieni.
Xuti mɨpaɨ katinita'eiya: ―Yanepɨtiyurieni naime kepemɨnerahɨawe.
Heyaka mɨrati'uximayatsiwatsie yapɨtikatɨa mu'eya kemɨtita'aitɨakai.

Wuhutsi tiukwaka meta tiu'ieka, puyutemawiekai. Hikɨ kaneyani hekahunike tsewara matixeɨrie warita. Hikɨ Xuti 'arikeke 'anɨari 'umietɨ kanaye'ani hetsɨana, 'ɨkayatɨa 'enuku'ɨkaripieka mana kaniukahuni.
Hikɨ Wuhutsi tɨkari hixɨapa kananutaniere, ta'aurie hawenike, 'ana 'ukaratsi puxei manuka'ɨkatsie 'ukaikame.
Mɨpaɨ katinita'iwawiya: ―¿Kepaikɨ pepɨyɨane? ―Ne Xuti nepɨyɨane, mati'uximayatsiriwame. 'A'ɨkari kɨtsimeyari keneneukaketɨa,
'ekɨ hɨritɨarika pepexeiya pemɨnetsitiwitɨnikɨ, tatɨɨriyama 'anuiwaritsie miemete memakɨnekɨ temɨ'iwamarixikɨ.
―Neniwe Yawé kematsi'ɨwiyani. Hikɨ hekwamekɨ kepemɨtiuyuri, pepɨ'ahekɨata kepemɨtiwiya 'amu'e hetsie, yaxeikɨata 'akɨnatɨkaitsie temari pemɨkawakuwaunekɨ, memɨkatehexeiya yatɨni memɨtehexeiya.
Hikɨ neniwe pepɨkaheumaka. Tita pemɨreuyehɨwa naime yanepɨtiyurieni. Yunaitɨ neteɨterima
yamepɨtemate 'ekɨ 'ukaratsi 'inɨari kepemɨtihɨkɨ yapemɨtikamiekɨ.
'Aixɨatsɨ kani'aneni temɨ'iwamarixikɨ perutsɨ matsi 'akuxi xewitɨ 'apuyeika kemɨ'ane mɨhɨritɨarie para mɨmatsiparewienikɨ.

Hikɨ tɨkaritsie 'ena keneu'ahayewa ximerike pepɨyemie. Xɨka mɨkɨ yara'eriwani, 'aixɨa kani'aneni yaketiuyurieni. Peru xɨka yakara'eriwani yamɨtiyurienikɨ, kaniyuritɨni Yawé mayenierekɨ, yurikɨ ne nepɨyɨhɨritɨa nepɨmatsiparewieni. Keneukaniri mana ximerikeri pekaniyemieni.
Hikɨ manuka'ɨkatsie 'ukaitɨ kaniukatariyarieni, tuxakɨta 'anukukeka kaneyani, mɨpaɨ mɨrehɨawekaikɨ: «Xewitɨ mɨkaretimanikɨ kename 'ukaratsi 'ena hekuyeixɨa mɨrati'uritɨretsie».
Hikɨta Wuhutsi mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: ―'Axikuri keneutawera, 'aixɨa ketinewiyani. Xuti mɨpaɨ katiniuyurieni, kanitawera yuxikuri. Mana kanikayatsirieni tsewara xeitewiyari kiruyari.
'Ititɨtɨaku kiekaritsie kaneyani.
Hikɨ kepauka Xuti meta'a yumu'e hetsɨa, kanita'iwawiya: ―Keperepariyarie, neniwe Xuti naime pɨtitaxatɨa, tewi hetsiena mieme kemɨreyuri,
mɨpaɨta kaniutayɨni: ―'Ikɨ tsewara pɨnetsihetɨtɨa xeitewiyari kiruyari, mɨpaɨ nerahɨawetɨ: “'Aixɨa pɨka'ane pe'amawetɨ pemeumieni 'amu'e hetsɨa”.
Hikɨ Nuhemi mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: ―Neuxei neniwe, 'akuxi keneta'ikwewani ketiyɨni. Mɨkɨ tewi yumexɨitɨatɨ pɨkatihayewa, 'aixɨa tiyurienike hikɨ tukariyaritsie.
